title: The EM-algorithm and the Method of Moments in Softmax Mixture Models
abstract: arXiv:2409.09903v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Softmax Mixture Models (SMMs) are discrete $K$-component mixture models for the probabilities of selecting one of $p$ candidate feature vectors $X_1,\ldots,X_p\in\mathbb{R}^L$ in heterogeneous populations and are widely used in econometrics and scientific applications. Related softmax mixture mechanisms also appear in modern LLM architectures. We provide a theoretical and methodological study of SMMs, focusing on the Expectation-Maximization (EM) algorithm and the Method of Moments (MoM). We show that EM recovers the mixture atoms at the parametric rate, up to logarithmic factors, after $\mathcal{O}(\log N)$ iterations, provided atom separation is at least of order $\log K$. This improves on separation conditions in existing analyses of EM for high-dimensional Gaussian mixtures. We also develop MoM procedures for parameter and subspace estimation. translated_title: Softmax混合模型中的EM算法与矩方法
translated_abstract: Softmax混合模型（SMMs）是离散的K分量混合模型，用于刻画异质总体中选择p个候选特征向量 $X_1,\ldots,X_p\in\mathbb{R}^L$ 之一的概率，广泛应用于计量经济学和各类科学应用中。相关的softmax混合机制也出现在现代大语言模型（LLM）架构中。我们对SMMs进行了理论与方法论研究，重点关注期望最大化（EM）算法和矩方法（MoM）。我们证明，在混合原子分离度至少为 $\log K$ 量级的条件下，EM算法经过 $\mathcal{O}(\log N)$ 次迭代后，能以参数速率（至多相差对数因子）恢复混合模型的原子。这改进了现有针对高维高斯混合模型EM分析中的分离条件。我们还开发了用于参数和子空间估计的矩方法程序。尽管MoM参数估计的收敛速度比EM更慢，且性能可能出现退化……
tldr: 本文对Softmax混合模型进行了理论与方法研究，证明在log K量级的原子分离条件下EM算法仅需O(log N)次迭代即可恢复混合原子，并为参数和子空间估计开发了矩方法。
en_tdlr: This paper provides a theoretical and methodological study of Softmax Mixture Models, proving that the EM algorithm recovers mixture atoms at the parametric rate within O(log N) iterations under a log K separation condition, and develops Method of Moments procedures for parameter and subspace estimation.
